import collections
target='c889cadf-ee1a-5783-816a-c60c58430141'
d=collections.defaultdict(float)
cnt=collections.Counter()
ids=set()
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    next(f)
    for row in f:
        parts=row.split(',')
        ids.add(parts[0])
        if parts[0]!=target: continue
        date=parts[1][:10]
        d[date]+=float(parts[2])
        cnt[date]+=1
print("n_ids",len(ids), target in ids)
for day in ('2018-04-24','2018-04-26'):
    print(day,d[day],cnt[day])
print("DIFF", d['2018-04-26']-d['2018-04-24'])
